title: Expandable Card
description: Expands into a centred panel with shared-layout transitions.

a11y.motion: The card snaps straight into the centred panel with no shared-layout spring; the backdrop keeps a short opacity fade.
a11y.keyboard: The card is a button that opens a modal dialog with Enter or Space. Focus moves into the dialog, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, Escape or Close dismisses it, and focus returns to the card.
a11y.screenReader: The card is announced as a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; the panel is a role="dialog" with aria-modal, named by its heading.
